title: Financial transparency, 2012–2021
summary: The cover of the association's 2012–2021 financial report, published so contributors can see where the money went.
body:
The 2012–2021 record sets out what the association collected, what it spent, and how each project was funded over the decade.

The association keeps the detailed accounts and publishes a summary so that anyone who contributes can see where the money went. The cover is with this record.
